hs: 1211.90 (plants and parts used in pharmacy/perfumery, other) — BROAD category, includes psyllium/isabgol
source_name: WITS (World Bank) / UN Comtrade — India exports by partner, calendar year 2024
notes: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE ON PRODUCT ATTRIBUTION — the underlying figures are primary-tier (WITS/UN Comtrade) and reliable, BUT HS 1211.90 is a broad basket covering many medicinal/perfumery plant materials, not psyllium alone. India is the dominant world origin for psyllium/isabgol and psyllium is understood to be a large share of this line, but the USD 535.24M total here must NOT be presented as 'India's psyllium husk exports' — that would overstate it. Use this table only with an explicit caveat that the code is broader than psyllium, or use it directionally to identify markets (USA ~31%, Germany, Italy) rather than as a psyllium-specific figure. A psyllium-specific number needs India's 8-digit ITC-HS line (1211 90 32 / 1211 90 33 territory), which was not accessible this session.
